title: Project conventions
requirements: 02.01. Classes and type aliases use PascalCase.
02.02. Functions, methods, parameters, variables, and attributes use camelCase.
02.03. Private attributes use a leading underscore followed by camelCase.
02.04. No project identifier has been converted to snake_case.
02.05. Every required public class and method has a useful docstring.
02.06. `__post_init__` methods have useful docstrings when present.
02.07. The file contains no unnecessary logging, compatibility layer, serialization support, unrelated abstraction, or additional public API.
02.08. The file contains no unnecessary import, cast, overload, helper, alias, property, method, variable, or type declaration.
